title: matchingData
description: Matching data for one network location and one matching period. It contains the matching period, time-series granularity, quantity unit and account-specific matching data.

period.description: Period covered by the matching data, represented as an ISO 8601 interval or duration expression.

granularity.description: Duration of each time-series interval. PT1H represents one hour.

unit.description: Unit of the quantities contained in the matching time series.

accountSpecificData.description: Matching data grouped by internal and external account for the network location and matching period.
